name: daylight-basement-back
comment: The basement-bull character seen from BEHIND, no face visible: an identity reference (hoodie, hair, headphones, joggers, sneakers, can) that fal's likeness checker has nothing to flag.
subject: Live-action documentary realism, a frame from a film shot on a full-frame cinema camera with a 50 mm lens: a dense pine forest at late golden hour, the low sun flaring between the trunks ahead, a faint glimpse of snow-capped mountains, dust and pollen in the light, fine film grain, true-to-life colour. No text, no logos.
negative: face, eyes, profile, turned head, text, letters, logos, brand names, cartoon, illustration, CGI look

styles.label: the same young man from behind, face not visible
styles.style: The same young man as in the reference image, seen entirely FROM BEHIND, his back to the camera, his face not visible at all: the same greasy dark hair, the oversized black hoodie with the hood down, big black headphones round his neck, baggy grey joggers, scuffed white sneakers; he stands on the forest path holding a matte black energy drink can with a plain green stripe in one hand and a phone in the other, looking away into the trees.
